scenarios.scenario_abstract: For a fifteen-day family trip through Swiss lake and Alpine bases, [X] selects one packable hooded weather layer for showers, exposed viewpoints, boat decks, cool evenings, and train transfers where luggage already occupies both hands.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为一家三口 15 天的瑞士湖区与阿尔卑斯山旅行选择天气外层时，[X]会选用一件便于压缩的连帽外层，以应对阵雨、暴露观景台、游船甲板、凉夜和双手已被行李占用的列车转乘。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: On a relaxed spring trip from Barcelona to Marseille and Cassis, [X] chooses a light hooded outer layer for Calanques boat spray, a breezy coastal walk, and sudden showers while keeping both hands available for boarding and luggage.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 从巴塞罗那前往马赛和卡西斯进行轻松春季旅行时，[X]会选择轻薄连帽外层，用于卡朗格乘船水雾、多风海岸步行和突发阵雨，同时腾出双手上下船与搬运行李。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: On a cool cloudy day, [X] layers an owned thin black bomber over a crewneck or T-shirt and avoids a hood that would bunch behind the jacket, press the neck, obscure its clean collar, and distort the shoulder line when worn open.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在阴冷多云的一天，[X]把已有的黑色轻薄飞行夹克叠穿在圆领衫或 T 恤外，并避开会在夹克后方堆积、压颈、遮住简洁领口且在敞开穿着时破坏肩线的帽子结构。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: During a first-week-of-March Paris visit, [X] selects a medium-warm hooded outer layer for damp wind, intermittent rain, long walks between metro and museums, and evening returns when carrying an umbrella through crowds would be awkward.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 三月第一周游览巴黎时，[X]会选择中等保暖的连帽外层，以应对湿冷风、间歇性降雨、地铁与博物馆之间的长距离步行，以及在人群中不便撑伞的夜间返程。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: On a two-week Bali route with frequent scooter transfers, temple visits, humid beaches, and brief showers, [X] chooses a light outer layer without a hood so the helmet and temple scarf fit predictably and no loose fabric enters the straps or catches the wind.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在包含频繁摩托车转乘、寺庙参观、湿热海滩和短时阵雨的两周巴厘岛路线中，[X]会选择不带帽的轻薄外层，让头盔和寺庙围巾稳定贴合，避免松散布料进入绑带或被风吹动。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For a June Cape Town trip, [X] chooses a warm hooded wind-and-rain layer for exposed viewpoints and garden walks where gusts make an umbrella unreliable and both hands may be needed for balance or a camera.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 六月前往开普敦时，[X]会选择保暖的连帽防风雨外层，用于阵风使雨伞不可靠的暴露观景点和花园步道，并在需要双手保持平衡或操作相机时仍能提供遮护。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For a Mumbai trip during possible monsoon rain, [X] chooses a light hooded outer layer that can be pulled up on station platforms while both hands and attention remain on a phone, crossbody bag, and luggage in dense transit.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在可能遇到季风雨的孟买旅行中，[X]会选择可以在车站站台直接拉起帽子的轻薄外层，同时把双手和注意力继续用于手机、斜挎包、行李与拥挤交通。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For a dry-stadium R&B concert, [X] chooses a removable outer layer without a hood so hours of dancing, packed seating, clear-bag straps, hearing, and peripheral crowd awareness are not disrupted by heat-trapping or snag-prone fabric around the head.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 参加天气干燥的体育场 R&B 演唱会时，[X]会选择不带帽的可脱外层，避免头部周围的布料在数小时舞动、拥挤座席和透明包带之间积热或勾挂，并维持听觉与周边人群感知。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: Before a freezing-afternoon appointment to compare luxury eyeglass frames, [X] chooses a knit top and a warm outer layer without a hood, keeping ears, hair, temples, and side views fully visible through repeated frame changes under shop and daylight conditions.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 严寒午后去比较多副高端眼镜框前，[X]会选择针织上装和不带帽的保暖外层，使耳部、头发、镜腿和侧面轮廓在店内与日光下反复换框时始终完整可见。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While building a Tracer cosplay around a bomber-jacket base, orange headpiece, short hair or wig, and pilot goggles, [X] keeps the upper garment free of a hood so the recognizable silhouette, straps, hair, and repeated convention adjustments remain unobstructed.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 以飞行夹克、橙色头饰、短发或假发和飞行员式护目镜制作 Tracer cosplay 时，[X]会让上装不带帽子，使角色辨识轮廓、绑带、头发和展会中的反复调整都不受阻碍。
